sentences.translation: # When you get big
today, i have a teacher at school.
what do you want to be when you're big?
everyone was a little bit angry.
i raised my hand.
i want to be a bastard!
my eyes were shining.
I want to help the person who is in the wolf.'
the teacher smiled.
emichan said next.
i want to be a baker.
emichan, you're a little bit loose.
i smelled the fresh bread. i want to make everyone smile with delicious bread.
this guy raised his hand slowly.
i want to be a wig.
"No, I'm wearing a rabbit. I was a bunny last week."
i continued to use a small knob.
so i want to be a person who can make a collision.
sakurachan saw the mado.
i want to be a scumbag!
sakurachan caught him with yubi.
i want to touch the earth. i want to see the earth from the bottom.
the teacher said, that's amazing.
rinchan said it to the saigo.
i want to be a kind person.
everyone in the class has shrunk.
rinchan, but she was looking straight ahead.
the teacher became a slumber.
and then slowly said
it's the hardest thing, and maybe the hardest thing.
the class has become smooth.
the teacher looked at everyone's face and smiled.
everyone is nice, please keep it.
i don't know yet about my yuume.
but rinchan's answer has always been my answer.
